notes.fault: test/integration/services-p1-self-referential-write.integration.test.js fails deterministically on qualified hardware: all 135 partition-service cache rows stuck raft_role=follower; only the message-group row shows leader. v0.1.0 passes; git bisect names b68b0e19a (2026-07-22, authoritative-row-mutation-helper retained-wake rewrite) as first bad commit.
notes.mechanism: services.raft_role has two writers with conflicting normalization and no interaction owner (doctrine s18 gap). (1) Role-mutation lane: partition-service-metadata-delivery-methods.js queueRoleUpdate collapses leader->follower (collapseLeaderToFollower:true, introduced 2026-03 "wip stabilizing node join under load"; message-group lane collapses identically). (2) Row-owner lane: PartitionServiceRowOwner.buildServiceRow stamps resolvePartitionRaftRole(service), which CAN be leader - but only fires at registration/activation. services-p1 activates BEFORE its 3-replica election completes, so the row is stamped follower and no lane ever upgrades it; mg-1 activation happens to run after its election, masking the same gap. At v0.1.0 the pre-rewrite helper let the row-owner leader survive; b68b0e19a changed which writer wins.

C: migrate all readers to partitions.leader_node_id and retire leader semantics from services.raft_role for partitions (largest blast radius; mg asymmetry remains). MUST be adversarially verified against the March hack rationale and the canonical-leader tenure quests before any implementation.
